n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

maxn = 505
C = [[0] * maxn for _ in range(maxn)]
f = [0] * maxn
g = [0] * maxn
F = [[0] * maxn for _ in range(maxn)]
G = [[0] * maxn for _ in range(maxn)]

for i in range(n + 1):
    C[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j]) % mod

f[0] = 1
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        temp1 = (f[j - 1] * f[i - j]) % mod
        temp1 = (temp1 * (i + 1)) % mod
        temp1 = (temp1 * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod
        f[i] = (f[i] + temp1) % mod

        temp2 = (f[j - 1] * g[i - j]) % mod
        temp2 = (temp2 * (i + 1)) % mod
        temp2 = (temp2 * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod
        g[i] = (g[i] + temp2) % mod

        temp3 = (g[j - 1] * f[i - j]) % mod
        temp3 = (temp3 * (i + 1)) % mod
        temp3 = (temp3 * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod
        g[i] = (g[i] + temp3) % mod

        sumC = (C[j][2] + C[i - j + 1][2]) % mod
        temp4 = (f[j - 1] * f[i - j]) % mod
        temp4 = (temp4 * sumC) % mod
        temp4 = (temp4 * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod
        g[i] = (g[i] + temp4) % mod

for i in range(n + 1):
    for j in range(min(i, m) + 1):
        for l in range(j):
            tempF = (f[l] * F[i - l - 1][j - l]) % mod
            tempF = (tempF * C[j][l]) % mod
            F[i][j] = (F[i][j] + tempF) % mod

            tempG1 = (g[l] * F[i - l - 1][j - l]) % mod
            tempG1 = (tempG1 * C[j][l]) % mod
            G[i][j] = (G[i][j] + tempG1) % mod

            tempG2 = (f[l] * G[i - l - 1][j - l]) % mod
            tempG2 = (tempG2 * C[j][l]) % mod
            G[i][j] = (G[i][j] + tempG2) % mod
        F[i][j] = (F[i][j] + f[j]) % mod
        G[i][j] = (G[i][j] + g[j]) % mod

print(G[n][m])
